title: Escaping my dream world PT 1
content: (For context this is a real dream I've had and is not made up) So in my hometown there is 2 real exits and this is just about the first exit. The exit that's not entirely blocked. In my dream world it's a different layout of the town that's completely messed up. Both exits you can't escape out of. If I try to leave theres supposed to be a town 20 minutes each way. My dream if I try to leave starts as just a normal road that leads up a small hill and has a bend to the left. Nothing out of the ordinary. On the right you can see the river far down the grassy bank and no cement median to block you from losing control coming down the opposite way. On the left it's the unknown forest of trees that I've never went in since I never have time. Once you get to the corner you basically go through an invisible portal or ripple in the dream or glitch and teleport up a snowy mountain and are immediately on a different version of the road. But whats weird is it morphs into a snowy mountain and it's a steep trail on a snowy cliff thats miles in the air. Withing seconds you're frozen trying to get off a strange mountain. Everytime I get confused how a normal street turned into a cross country ski path. In this dream I never can make it around the corner without falling off the cliff and dying. I've skied down it and died off the cliff. I've tried walking around it but I had no snowshoes and slid off. I've also suffocated alive in the snow and my mom couldnt save me. One time she did save me which made me relieved since I had relived this fate so many times. At this point I'm convinced a group of people are trapped among a sleep corner up a snowy mountain and no one can hear them scream. The dream makes me wanna vomit because once I realize where I am I know I've seen it before. It's not just a dream but a whole world I haven't explored.
